courses.synopsis: The housing needs of families. Economic, social and psychological factors involved in renting and buying a house. Housing standards; Principles design, and layout of different types. Rural housing and community development. Planning and design criteria for rural housing. Local materials for rural housing. Public participation in housing development. A study of the housing policies of Federal and State Governments of Nigeria. Various methods of financing house investment in the public, private and cooperative sectors.
